verdict.rationale: Undermind produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis, and can create and edit Markdown notes, syntheses and reports with in-line citations. A community user also describes a 'Discovery Progress and Exhaustiveness' section, so the output has some sectioned structure. Missing for 10: evidence of tables in the generated report output (tables are only mentioned as PDF input it can read), any sharing or export path for stakeholders, documentation of a standard report layout or executive summary, and independent hands-on corroboration of report quality.
